title: Trump honors Rudy Giuliani with presidential medal of freedom
summary_full: President’s former lawyer, disbarred over effort to overturn 2020 election result, receives top civilian honorDonald Trump awarded Rudy Giuliani, his former personal attorney who was disbarred for his efforts to help the US president overturn 2020 election results, with the presidential medal of freedom on Tuesday.The presidential medal of freedom is one of the highest civilian awards in the US, typically given to individuals who contribute to world peace, the national interest of the US or significant cultural endeavors.
